title: Hymns from the East
author: brownlie
attributionNote: Recorded in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library under John (1857-1925) Brownlie (10 classics). The site catalogues the work at https://ccel.org/ccel/brownlie/hymnseast, whose own card names the print edition transcribed here; where the site carries a title by a publisher's permission rather than in public domain, this library does not take it.
description: Hymns from the East — the English text the Christian Classics Ethereal Library publishes for this work, on the site's Hymns shelf. The record was created by the CCEL import from the site's own catalogue and plain text; an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's catalogue, whose shelves follow the site's own division of Christian literature, and whose transcription follows the print edition Paisley: Alexander Gardner, 1907.
availabilityNote: Complete in the Christian Classics Ethereal Library's plain-text edition: 5 chapter(s), 23 paragraph(s), 219 words. The divisions are the headings of the site's own text, which the library stores rather than asking the site for again when the work is read. The text is public domain and is displayed with the library's credit.
